title: Science Lab
subtitle: 19 simulations
description: Real physics, chemistry and biology simulations with missions and equations.

items.title: The Elements
subtitle: chemistry
physics
items.body: All 118 elements in an interactive periodic table: spin each atom in 3-D as shells or real orbital clouds, see its spectral fingerprint, compare, quiz, print cards and hear the elements as sound.

items.title: Magnetic Bottles for Fusion
subtitle: physics
items.body: Turn, slice and mirror-test two exact 3-D magnetic bottles for fusion from a new 2026 paper, and see why the field lines must twist.

meta.title: Magnetic Bottles for Fusion

items.title: Newton’s Laws of Motion
subtitle: physics
items.body: A six-chapter unit: Galileo’s ramps, F = ma with live graphs, skaters pushing apart, ramps and pulleys, crashes and momentum, and the apple and the Moon.

meta.title: Newton’s Laws of Motion
meta.text: A six-chapter unit: Galileo’s ramps, F = ma with live graphs, skaters pushing apart, ramps and pulleys, crashes and momentum, and the apple and the Moon.

items.title: The Laws of Thermodynamics
subtitle: physics
chemistry
items.body: A five-chapter unit: heat flowing between blocks, a piston on a P–V diagram, a gas run backward in time, Maxwell’s demon, Carnot’s engine and the road to absolute zero.

meta.title: The Laws of Thermodynamics
meta.text: A five-chapter unit: heat flowing between blocks, a piston on a P–V diagram, a gas run backward in time, Maxwell’s demon, Carnot’s engine and the road to absolute zero.

items.title: Book Cart
subtitle: physics
items.body: Swing a chain of 2 to 25 books up from a rolling cart and balance it, or stand every book dead straight: the inverted pendulum, with live forces and energy.

meta.title: Book Cart

items.title: Orbit Lab
subtitle: physics
astronomy
items.body: Fire Newton's cannon until the ball falls all the way around the world, put satellites in orbit, fly to the Moon and slingshot past Venus, with real gravity and Kepler's laws.

meta.text: Fire Newton's cannon until the ball falls all the way around the world, put satellites in orbit, fly to the Moon and slingshot past Venus, with real gravity and Kepler's laws.

items.title: Rocket Builder
subtitle: physics
items.body: Build a rocket from engines, tanks and up to three stages, then fly it to space, to orbit or away from Earth, and see why orbit means going sideways fast.

meta.title: Rocket Builder
meta.text: Build a rocket from engines, tanks and up to three stages, then fly it to space, to orbit or away from Earth, and see why orbit means going sideways fast.

items.title: Trebuchet Workshop
subtitle: physics
items.body: Tune a counterweight trebuchet to hit a tower 100 to 300 meters away, follow the falling weight's energy, and see why air drag pulls the best angle below 45°.

meta.title: Trebuchet Workshop

items.title: Pendulums and Resonance
subtitle: physics
items.body: Fifteen pendulums that fall out of step and line up again, two that pass a swing back and forth, and a swing that small, well-timed pushes send high.

meta.title: Pendulums and Resonance

items.title: Circuit Builder
subtitle: physics
items.body: Wire batteries, bulbs, switches, resistors and an LED on a breadboard and watch the current flow. Series and parallel, Ohm's law with real meters, and why an LED needs a resistor.

meta.title: Circuit Builder
meta.text: Wire batteries, bulbs, switches, resistors and an LED on a breadboard and watch the current flow. Series and parallel, Ohm's law with real meters, and why an LED needs a resistor.

items.title: Circuit Bench
subtitle: physics
items.body: Wires snap only to terminals, and the bench shows a gap or a short before you let go. Ten challenges: series and parallel, an LED's resistor, Morse's telegraph, a staircase switch and a broken bulb to find.

meta.title: Circuit Bench
meta.text: Wires snap only to terminals, and the bench shows a gap or a short before you let go. Ten challenges: series and parallel, an LED's resistor, Morse's telegraph, a staircase switch and a broken bulb to find.

items.title: Optics Bench
subtitle: physics
items.body: Bend, bounce and focus light with lasers, mirrors, lenses and prisms, trap it in a glass rod, and find the rainbow's 42° angle in a raindrop.

meta.title: Optics Bench
meta.text: Bend, bounce and focus light with lasers, mirrors, lenses and prisms, trap it in a glass rod, and find the rainbow's 42° angle in a raindrop.

items.title: Gas in a Box
subtitle: chemistry
physics
items.body: Squeeze a box of helium and argon atoms with a piston, heat the walls and pull out the divider: temperature is motion, pressure is collisions, and a bike pump gets warm.

items.title: Mixing Lab
subtitle: chemistry
items.body: Test kitchen liquids with four indicators, neutralize an acid, titrate drop by drop and speed up a reaction, on a bench where nothing can spill.

meta.title: Mixing Lab

items.title: Equation Balancer
subtitle: chemistry
items.body: Drag whole molecules, drawn as colored balls, into a chemical equation until every atom is counted on both sides. Twenty-seven reactions, from making water to photosynthesis.

items.title: Build an Atom
subtitle: chemistry
physics
items.body: Build atoms from protons, neutrons and electrons, make ions and isotopes, then watch radioactive nuclei decay and carbon-date a mystery sample.

items.title: Sky and Solar System
subtitle: astronomy
items.body: Set any date from 1800 to 2050 and see where the planets were, watch Mars loop backwards, run the Moon through its phases and find the eclipse seasons.

items.title: Predators and Prey
subtitle: biology
items.body: Grass, rabbits and foxes rise and fall in turns. Overhunt, add a refuge, ride out a hard winter, and compare the field with the Lotka–Volterra equations.

items.title: Cube Solver
subtitle: physics
items.body: Paint in the colors of your 2×2, 3×3 or 4×4 twisty puzzle cube and watch a 3-D cube play the moves that solve it. Fewest moves or the beginner method, with practice cases, notation, parity and a timer.
